title: Warpage through lead-free reflow, SYN-10001 Rev C

step3_rows.testsToBePerformed: Warpage (coplanarity and shape) during reflow simulation, shadow moire, captured at 25 C, 150 C, 183 C, 217 C, peak 260 C and 25 C after cooling
step3_rows.applicableSpecifications: SYN-TM-101 Warpage Measurement During Reflow Simulation; SYN-PR-201 Sample Preparation and Moisture Preconditioning; SYN-RP-301 Reporting
step3_rows.specificationRevision: SYN-TM-101 Rev C; SYN-PR-201 Rev B; SYN-RP-301 Rev A

fields.additionalInformation:
Objective: confirm coplanarity stays within 0.10 mm at peak reflow temperature for customer qualification.
Thermal profile: ramp 1.5 C/s to 150 C, soak 150-200 C for 90 s, time above 217 C for 75 s, peak 260 C, cooling 3 C/s. Profile file attached (profile_260.pdf).
Measurement area: full terminal seating plane, datum = three standoffs.
Samples: as-molded, stored in moisture barrier bags since molding (2026-11-02). Bake 125 C / 24 h per SYN-PR-201 before baseline.
Acceptance limit: 0.10 mm coplanarity at every capture temperature.
Report: coplanarity table per sample and temperature, contour maps for the worst sample only.

_why_good: States the objective and the decision it supports, with the acceptance limit.
Gives the full thermal profile and capture temperatures, so the lab can check them against the chamber limits.
Names the measurement area and datum, so results are comparable.
Gives storage history and preconditioning, the most common reason warpage results are rejected.
Cites procedures with revisions, and asks for contour maps only where needed.
